title: Sabra Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results; Reiterates 2026 Guidance
summary: Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc. (“Sabra,” the “Company” or “we”) (Nasdaq: SBRA) today announced its results of operations for the second quarter of 2026.
